title: Relative finite Tor dimension of a perfect complex
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $X$ quasi-compact (every open cover has a finite subcover) and $Y$ Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact). Let $f:X\to Y$ be locally of finite type (on affine charts the coordinate algebra is finitely generated over the base coordinate ring), and assume that every stalk $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ has finite Tor dimension as an $\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}$-module through the stalk map of $f$ [def-pc-perfect-morphism]. If $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], then $E$ has finite Tor dimension over $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$ [def-pc-finite-tor-dimension-over].

proof.text: Local finite type over a Noetherian base implies pseudo-coherence of f. Apply the stalk criterion for perfect morphisms (Tag 069C, lemma-check-perfect-stalks, (3) implies (2)) to [def-pc-perfect-morphism]. This gives neighbourhoods where the structure sheaf has finite Tor amplitude over the inverse-image structure sheaf. The pseudo-coherence hypothesis is essential: compactness alone does not bound pointwise Tor dimensions.

Intersect these neighbourhoods with the strictly perfect neighbourhoods of E [def-pc-perfect-complex]. If the local model has terms in [r,s] and the structure sheaf has amplitude [-d,0], finite free terms and their retracts have amplitude [-d,0]. Filter the bounded complex by its terms and use the long exact sequences of derived tensor cohomology to obtain amplitude [r-d,s]. Choose a finite subcover of X and enclose these intervals in one interval [a,b], with a≤b. A global representative and a K-flat resolution of its scalar restriction then compute every relative tensor product; its cohomology outside [a,b] vanishes locally and hence globally. These are precisely the witnesses in [def-pc-finite-tor-dimension-over]. Empty X and the zero complex permit [0,0].

theorem perfect_hasFiniteTorDimensionOver
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (hperfect : HasStalkwiseFiniteTorDimension f)
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPerfect X E) :
    HasFiniteTorDimensionOver f E
